provenance: Source: Issue #122 PREFLIGHT_VALID / ZERO_INFERENCE → Issue #125 readiness review

reason: The accepted isolated preflight checks pair identity and metadata only; it intentionally does not load the model/projector or handle an image reference.
No separately governed multimodal OCR runner exists that can fail-closed validate a non-persisted local image reference and emit ADR-003 OCR terminal classes.
Vulkan/backend compatibility, default projector placement, per-device memory fit, image-token budget, OCR prompt contract, quality, and performance are not established.

logical_workload.image_input: non-persisted local synthetic fixture governed by a separate execution issue
logical_workload.image_token_policy: Begin with one documented low visual-token budget selected by the future runner; do not use upstream maximum 16384 visual tokens as a target default.
logical_workload.generation_cap: A future execution issue must select a small bounded cap and record it in a sanitized receipt; no prompt or generated text may be persisted.

configuration_sequence.purpose: Separate runner/model-projector contract and non-persisted image-reference validation only
configuration_sequence.device: CPU or future approved safe loader mode
configuration_sequence.execution_gate: Separate owner-authorized implementation and dry-run review required
Only if future safe runner dry-run proves its exact one-job scope
Run only after a successful and classified Vulkan0 result
Run only after matched single-device results; projector placement must be observable or explicitly unresolved

configuration_sequence.purpose: One GPU1-biased follow-up only if 1,1 reveals GPU0 pressure and the first result is investigated
configuration_sequence.execution_gate: Not a default sweep; requires a falsifiable memory-placement hypothesis and separate review

configuration_sequence.purpose: First bounded context step after a successful 1024 f16 configuration
configuration_sequence.device: configuration selected by prior classified result
configuration_sequence.execution_gate: Only after successful baseline; stop on first surprise

configuration_sequence.purpose: One justified KV comparison only if f16 capacity is the observed blocker
configuration_sequence.execution_gate: Requires a documented f16 capacity hypothesis; no q4_0 or no-kv-offload sweep

explicit_exclusions: No tensor or row split: Vulkan split buffers are unsupported on this testbed.
No 2,1, 2,3, 3,2, or full-ratio sweep without a later evidence-backed hypothesis.
No context above 2048 in the first execution increment; 4096/8192 require prior results and a separate bounded review.
No q4_0 or --no-kv-offload without a distinct observed capacity or latency hypothesis.
No multi-image, video, URL, base64, or persisted image-content workload.

required_pre_execution_deliverables: A separate open implementation issue for a multimodal OCR runner that preserves ADR-003 isolation and validates a non-persisted local image reference before invocation.
Tests proving image-reference rejection, sanitization, paired binding, distinct OCR terminal receipt classes, and no regression of src/runner.py.
A reviewed model-specific execution plan and fresh dry-run with exact command family, one configuration/job, target backend, output isolation, and expected receipt fields.
Explicit owner authorization after the reviewed dry-run for the first bounded image/OCR execution only.

may_persist: paired artifact basenames, sizes, SHA-256, and pairing ID
terminal class and sanitized aggregate metrics
must_not_persist: image bytes, original filename, path, URL, or base64
prompt, OCR text, generated response, stdout, stderr, command arguments, or exception payload
credentials, private host identifiers, or absolute paths

stop_conditions: artifact identity, checksum, or pairing mismatch
missing separate runner/receipt contract or failing tests
dry-run scope, count, command family, or output-isolation mismatch
first unexpected load, backend, memory, tokenizer, image-validation, or artifact-write outcome
missing explicit owner authorization before image/OCR execution
non_claims: This plan is not approval to acquire or process an image.
This plan is not approval to run model loading, OCR inference, benchmark execution, or deployment.
This plan does not establish Qwen2-VL Vulkan compatibility, projector placement, per-device fit, OCR quality, speed, capacity, or publication eligibility.
